title: Prediction: echo spacing and PBH polarization drift read the same $\sqrt{z}$

statements.text: The echo spacing $\Delta t / \Delta t_0 \propto \sqrt{z}$ in gravitational-wave ringdowns and the polarization drift coefficient of late primordial black hole evaporation, $\bar\alpha \propto \sqrt{z}$, depend on one impedance contrast $z$, so the value inferred from each channel must agree.
statements.falsification_criteria: The values of $z$ inferred from echo spacing and from polarization drift disagree beyond the uncertainties of $\delta / R_{\mathrm{cav}}$ and the flux normalization.

prediction.resolution_criterion: Independent estimates of $z$ from gravitational-wave echo spacing and from the polarization drift of high-energy primordial black hole emission agree within their stated uncertainties.

sources.quote: Agreement across channels supports the effective boundary-layer description, while disagreement rules it out.
so the drift rate increases with the same square-root dependence on z that controls the echo spacing.
